**brief:** these brief probes now run inside the brief's own process as Rust steps instead of starting Python, `rg` or `pixel` once per probe: `test-bodies`, `workspace-overview`, `overview-answer-evidence`, `cand-k-member-manifest`, `doc-sections`, `name-files`, `config-registry`, `cand-j-chain`, `cand-j-callers`, `cand-k-code-sites`, `error-origin`, `flow-rank`, `cand-j-stop-cause`, `history-fallback`, `cand-k-commit-patch`, `rank-blocks`, and `prune-noise` where its probe is installed (a new post stage that runs on the finished brief). Same blocks, gating and budget, and `pixel plugin disable <name>` or `PIXEL_BRIEF_PROBES=0` still switches them off.
